data.body:
Final closure report:

- Proven root cause / AC3: `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py::plan_review_precheck`'s ordinary bug-tier branch ran `run_det_floor`, then downgraded every DET block except P4 to advisory. P1/P10 were detected for `classical-grey-ayeaye` but discarded before the LLM tier, allowing a PASS+signature; task siblings kept P1/P10 blocking and short-circuited. The fix keeps P1/P10/P4 authoritative in the bug tier and leaves other non-readiness DET findings advisory.
- Origin / caused_by: introducing commit `cbc5b2880eb804d1d9c0aa73a791bd04bda827e1` (`03a9: necessity/no-op probe + lightweight bug review tier (R4, advisory)`), ticket `clerkish-cloggy-cod` / `03a9-e6d1-4acc-435d`; linked and closed with `--caused-by=clerkish-cloggy-cod`.
- RED→GREEN / mutation: RED test `tests/unit/test_bug_review_tier.py -k plan_review_bug_floor` failed before the fix because the bug fixture returned `run_llm=True`; GREEN after preserving P1/P10/P4 as blocking. Mutation check reverting `_BUG_TIER_BLOCKING_DET_CRITERIA` to `{"P4"}` made the held-out regression fail RED again.
- Validation: expanded targeted suites passed (76 passed); `tests/ -k "plan_review and floor"` passed (65 passed, 3 skipped); `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `rebar explain plan` smoke, and `git diff --check` passed.
- AC4 scan: other signed attestations minted over plans lacking acceptance criteria and needing re-review were listed in the earlier AC4 comment: `ruinable-priggish-silverfish`, `operatic-melting-egg`, `hexadic-recognized-flea`, `camoflage-delirious-dowitcher`, `earthly-wraithlike-urson`, `injurious-definable-badger`, `enstatite-organic-geese`, `semidry-alien-nilgai`, `scratchy-leprous-galago`, `seraphic-taming-terrier`, `glad-monotonous-greatargus`, `epidermic-commodious-opossum`, `unbeaten-tense-mosquito`, `compulsory-pernickety-mantis`, `civil-electoral-lcont`.
- Gerrit: change 2532 merged at `1d3e4f144c922912fd265e4b4d03bd6ae882ef84`; final labels before submit were `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, unresolved comments 0.
- Final status: closed as `regression`.
